title: Sleeps 18 • 8BR Home w/ Pool, Backyard & Smart TVs
description:
Bring your group together at this spacious 8-bedroom home designed for family trips, sports teams, reunions, graduations, golf weekends, and group getaways. Enjoy a private pool, large backyard, outdoor grill, arcade game, smart TVs in every bedroom, fast Wi-Fi, and a fully equipped kitchen. Conveniently located near ASU, Tempe, Scottsdale, spring training stadiums, and Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport. Comfortably accommodates up to 18 guests.

 The space 
Bring your group together at this spacious 8-bedroom home designed for family vacations, sports teams, reunions, graduations, golf trips, and group getaways. With room for up to 18 guests, the home offers plenty of space to gather, relax, and enjoy your stay without feeling crowded.

The large backyard features a private pool, outdoor seating, and a BBQ grill for enjoying the Arizona sunshine. Inside, guests can enjoy an arcade game, fast Wi-Fi, smart TVs in every bedroom, and multiple comfortable gathering areas.

The fully equipped kitchen includes cookware, dishes, utensils, appliances, and essentials for preparing meals at home. Indoor and outdoor dining areas make it easy for larger groups to eat and spend time together.

Sleeping Arrangements

Bedroom 1 – King bed
Bedroom 2 – King bed
Bedroom 3 – King bed
Bedroom 4 – Queen bed
Bedroom 5 – King bed
Bedroom 6 – Queen bed
Bedroom 7 – King bed
Bedroom 8 – Queen-over-queen bunk bed

The home has eight bedrooms with nine individual sleeping surfaces and accommodates up to 18 guests.

Additional Features

• Private pool
• Large backyard with outdoor seating
• BBQ grill
• Arcade game
• Smart TV in every bedroom
• Fast Wi-Fi
• Fully equipped kitchen
• Indoor and outdoor dining areas
• Washer and dryer
• Self check-in with keyless entry
• Free driveway parking
• Public street parking available

Conveniently located near ASU, Tempe, Scottsdale, spring training stadiums, golf courses, restaurants, shopping, and Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport.

 Guest access 
Guests have full private access to the entire home and property, including all eight bedrooms, the private pool, backyard, arcade area, kitchen, laundry area, and indoor living spaces.

Self check-in with keyless entry makes arrival simple and convenient. Detailed check-in instructions and the access code will be provided before arrival.

 Other things to note 
To help keep the home comfortable and enjoyable for everyone, please keep the following in mind:

• Smoking and vaping are not permitted anywhere on the property
• Parties and events are not permitted
• Only registered guests included on the reservation may enter the property
• Quiet hours are from 10 PM to 8 AM
• Please be considerate of our neighbors, especially when using the backyard and pool area

Pet Policy

Up to 2 dogs are permitted with prior approval. A $250 fee applies per dog, per stay. All dogs must be disclosed before arrival and walked off-property for bathroom breaks, as the backyard is covered with artificial turf.

Guests are responsible for cleaning up after their pets and for any additional cleaning or damage caused during the stay.

Guest Pricing

Base pricing includes up to 10 guests. An additional nightly fee applies for guests 11–18. All overnight guests must be included on the reservation.

Thank you for helping us take care of the home and maintain a comfortable environment for our guests and neighbors.
